title: Card Allowances per Northgate Membership Tier
content:
Each Northgate Memberships tier carries its own allowance of cards beyond the primary member's card: free household cards, paid business add-on cards, replacements member services may issue in a membership year, and the photo requirement for a newly added cardholder.

## Allowance table

| Tier | Free household cards | Minimum age of a household cardholder | Household cardholder must live at the primary member's address | Maximum paid business add-on cards active at once | Replacement cards member services may issue per membership year | New cardholder's card activated only after a photo at a club membership counter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 0 | 18 years | Yes | 0 | 2 | Yes |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 1 | 18 years | Yes | 0 | 2 | Yes |
| Northgate Club Membership | 1 | 18 years | Yes | 0 | 2 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Membership | 1 | 18 years | No | 8 | 3 | Yes |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 1 | 18 years | Yes | 0 | 2 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 1 | 18 years | No | 8 | 3 | Yes |

## Notes

- **Household cards** are included free with the membership; the Student Club tier includes none.
- **Same address.** The consumer tiers require the household cardholder to live at the primary member's address; the two business tiers do not.
- **Business add-on cards** are paid cards; only the two business tiers allow them, up to 8 active at once.
- **Replacement cards.** Member services may issue 2 replacement cards in one membership year on a consumer tier and 3 on a business tier.
- **Photo.** At every tier a newly added cardholder's card is activated only after the cardholder's photo is taken at a club membership counter.

## Hypothetical comparisons

| Situation (hypothetical) | Consumer tier with household cards | Business tier |
|---|---|---|
| Household cardholder aged 18 living at another address | address requirement not met | address not required |
| Ninth paid add-on card while 8 are active | add-on cards not available | above the maximum of 8 |
| Third replacement card asked of member services in one membership year | above the 2 allowed | within the 3 allowed |
